Exact report from Aha on the first chapter is given here by Shimon bar Karsana. Heilprin records bar Kana. Preserve the witness difference and the attributed equivalence.
Karsana also transmits explicitly in Aha’s name here, but the teaching is separate. It provides no proof of a Kana/Sana spelling in the printed Avodah Zarah locus.
The printed Kana is independently distinguishable from the checked digital Karsana.
This remains Heilprin’s stated identity proposal. The checked first-chapter witness reads a third form, Karsana.
The claimed equivalence remains local and attributed.
